table.name: TLGNC_MAT_SHIPPINGPOINT
table.description: Additional Material data depending on Material+Shippingpoint(+Plant) which is not maintained in SAP but directly in Logon. See also tlgnc_mat_plant for Material+Plant dependent data.

column.name: SAP_MATERIAL_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_material. Material (Product) of this extended Logon data. Note, this is NOT the SAP Material Number, but the technical ID of that material in Logon DB. (SAP_MATERIAL_ID, SHIPPINGPOINT_ID) is an alternative identifier.

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. Shippingpoint of this extended Logon data. Note, this is NOT the SAP Shippingpoint Number (which would only be identifying in combination with plant_cd), but the technical ID of that shippingpoint in Logon DB. The plant can be seen in tlgnc_shippingoint.plant_cd.

column.name: STORAGE_LOCATION
column.description: The Storage Location where the material is kept at this shippingpoint. Value is used when exporting the order to SAP. It ALWAYS wins over tlgnc_shippingpoint.storage_location, i.e. it is possible to override a value also with NULL/empty. This value can only be set for materials where material_package_cd.can_have_storage_location _flag = 1. E.g. 'Services' cannot have a storage location.

column.name: VAR_HANDLING_COST_MAT
column.description: Current variable handling cost of material (per 1 BASE_UOM_CD of the material from SAP), material-specific. These are costs caused when handling (loading/unloading) a certain material at a plant. If the handling costs are independent of the material (=default), they are set in tlgnc_shippingpoint, but can be overridden here. Handling costs occur at each plant which is involved, i.e. production and supply plant (if different). The UOM is implicitely the same as for the material received from SAP: tlgns_sap_material.BASE_UOM_CD.

column.name: FUTURE_VAR_HANDLING_COST_MAT
column.description: Future variable handling cost of material (per 1 UOM).

column.name: FUTURE_VALID_FROM_DAT
column.description: Validity start date of future_var_handling_cost_mat. Current costs are valid until before future_valid_from_dat. Moving 'future' into 'current' and updating the future_valid_from_dat is a manual task, done once per year. Logon compares delivery date of order with this date and decides which cost is to be used.

column.name: CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_currency_bs. Currency in which the handling costs caused by this Shippingpoint are expressed. Exchange rates in tlgnc_currency_exch_rate must be respected when adding costs of various sources in one order_item.
